title: Planning & Optimization Senior Expert
desc:
Join Us
At Vodafone, we’re not just shaping the future of connectivity for our customers – we’re shaping the future for everyone who joins our team. When you work with us, you’re part of a global mission to connect people, solve complex challenges, and create a sustainable and more inclusive world. If you want to grow your career whilst finding the perfect balance between work and life, Vodafone offers the opportunities to help you belong and make a real impact.
What You’ll Do
Responsible from plan and optimize of regional radio network with the smart network strategies for the best network experience
To implement alternative coverage and capacity solutions for both In building and outdoor locations so as to minimize the investment while maximizing the impact on the network’s performance
Reviewing, testing and implementing the new products, tools and manage special projects, trials for new technologies
Perform 2G/4G/5G site planning and optimization using related tools
Capacity and congestion management and dimensioning
Leading the RF projects, ensure the completion within timelines
Analysis of KPIs, detailed 4G/5G parameter audits, fine tuning and inconsistency checks based on new features and network requirement
Knowledge of Huawei equipments, features and parameters
RAN protocols, trace collection and analysis
Thorough knowledge on antennas structure, propagation and link budget
Big event management experience
Provide support to drivet test teams
Who You Are
Graduated from Electrical/Electronics/Communication engineering departments
10+ years of mobile technology experience
Good command of English
Strong planning & organizing skills
Strong analytical and excellent problem-solving skills
Engagement with internal stakeholders in cross-functional organization
Expertise in RF planing and optimization, DT measurement and post-processing tools (ex. Atoll, Mapinfo, Tems, Actix, Son Master, M2000, Discovery)
Strong database / sql / python skills
Has to have Driving License in B Class
Who We Are
We are a leading international Telco, serving millions of customers. At Vodafone, we believe that connectivity is a force for good. If we use it for the things that really matter, it can improve people's lives and the world around us. Through our technology we empower people, connecting everyone regardless of who they are or where they live and we protect the planet, whilst helping our customers do the same.
Belonging at Vodafone isn't a concept; it's lived, breathed, and cultivated through everything we do. You'll be part of a global and diverse community, with many different minds, abilities, backgrounds and cultures. ;We're committed to increase diversity, ensure equal representation, and make Vodafone a place everyone feels safe, valued and included.
If you require any reasonable adjustments or have an accessibility request as part of your recruitment journey, for example, extended time or breaks in between online assessments, please refer to https://careers.vodafone.com/application-adjustments/ for guidance.
